payload.posture: Read Mark 14:27–31 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states after Jesus predicts scattering and reunion in Galilee, Peter distinguishes himself from the others and denies the predicted denial emphatically. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
